name: sub-meter
description: Your subscription usage at the bottom right of Claude Code: the 5-hour and weekly windows, and the context window's fill, as a bar that takes turns.

rotateSeconds.title: Seconds per window
rotateSeconds.description: How long the meter shows each window (5-hour, weekly, context) before it switches to the next.

showContext.title: Show the context window
showContext.description: Take a turn with the context window's fill (tokens over the window) after the subscription windows.

hideCycleHint.title: Hide the mode cycle hint
hideCycleHint.description: Drop "(shift+tab to cycle)" after the permission mode, to leave room for the meter.

hideInterruptHint.title: Hide the interrupt hint
hideInterruptHint.description: Drop "esc to interrupt" from the hint line while Claude works, to leave room for the meter.
